result.summary: Found 1 issue on the page regarding layout/content overlap.

issues.description: The category filter chips at the top have a horizontal scrollable behavior, but the rightmost visible chip ('Healthy') and the one partially off-screen overlap slightly with the edge, although standard horizontal scroll rules exclude the last clipped item, the spacing could be better.
